تعرقبتما (form IIq)
# تَعَرْقَبْتُمَا (taʕarqabtumā) /ta.ʕar.qab.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُعُرْقِبْتُمَا (tuʕurqibtumā) /tu.ʕur.qib.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
